The PRICE-LED signal (E12) also suggests that the market may be expecting more from the company than what it has delivered so far, indicating room for improvement and potentially higher returns. In conclusion, Dhenu Buildcon Infra Ltd appears to have significant untapped upside given its strong recent sales growth and sector outperformance, despite current challenges. The stock is likely undervalued based on its earnings momentum and could be a worthwhile investment opportunity.
